'''Jean Bricmont''' ({{IPA|fr|bʁikmɔ̃|lang}}; born 12 April 1952) is a [[Belgium|Belgian]] [[theoretical physics|theoretical physicist]] and [[Philosophy of science|philosopher of science]]. [[Professor]] at the [[Université catholique de Louvain|Catholic University of Louvain]] (UCLouvain), he works on [[renormalization group]] and nonlinear [[differential equation]]s. Since 2004, Bricmont is a member of the Division of Sciences of the [[Royal Academy of Science, Letters and Fine Arts of Belgium|Royal Academy of Belgium]].<ref>[http://academieroyale.be/n377/Jean.Bricmont Jean Bricmont] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171012053858/http://www.academieroyale.be/n377/Jean.Bricmont |date=12 October 2017 }} page on [[Royal Academy of Science, Letters and Fine Arts of Belgium|Royal Academy of Belgium]] website.</ref>

Bricmont describes himself as a rationalist.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2002-03-12 |title=Entretien avec Jean Bricmont: la gauche face à la science |url=https://solidarites.ch/journal/5-2/entretien-avec-jean-bricmont-la-gauche-face-a-la-science/ |access-date=2025-02-09 |website=solidaritéS |language=fr-FR}}</ref> He has criticized [[Postmodernism|postmodernist]] views of science along with [[Alan Sokal]], with whom he wrote ''[[Fashionable Nonsense]]'' (1997). He has also criticized [[imperialism]] and defended [[Freedom of speech|freedom of expression]], adopting a position on the issue similar to that of [[Noam Chomsky]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Bricmont|first=Jean|date=2001-04-01|title=La mauvaise réputation de Noam Chomsky|url=https://www.monde-diplomatique.fr/2001/04/BRICMONT/1829|access-date=2020-08-11|website=Le Monde diplomatique|language=fr}}</ref>{{primary source inline|date=April 2024}}

Jean Bricmont was president of the [[Association française pour l'information scientifique]] from 2001 to 2006.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.pseudo-sciences.org/Qui-sommes-nous|title = Qui sommes-nous ? / Afis Science - Association française pour l'information scientifique}}</ref>

==Books==
* ''Impérialisme humanitaire'' (2005) published in English as ''Humanitarian Imperialism'',<ref>{{cite book | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=YalGBAAAQBAJ | title=Humanitarian Imperialism: Using Human Rights to Sell War | isbn=978-1-58367-488-8 | last1=Bricmont | first1=Jean | date=November 2006 | publisher=NYU Press }}</ref> 2006 {{LCCN|2006034221}} {{isbn|1-58367-147-1}}<ref>{{Cite web|last=Johnstone|first=Diana|title=Monthly Review {{!}} Humanitarian Imperialism: Using Human Rights to Sell War|url=https://monthlyreview.org/9781583671474/|access-date=2020-08-11|website=Monthly Review|date=31 October 2002 |language=en-US}}</ref>
* Preface to ''L'Atlas alternatif'' – Frédéric Delorca (ed), Pantin, Temps des Cerises, 2006
* ''Raison contre pouvoir. Le Pari de Pascal'' Jean Bricmont and [[Noam Chomsky]], 5 November 2009
* ''La République des censeurs'', ''L'Herne''. 2014. {{ISBN|978-2851974570}}.
* {{cite book|last1=Bricmont|first1=Jean|title=Making Sense of Quantum Mechanics|date=2016|publisher=Springer|isbn=978-3319258898|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=9O9eCwAAQBAJ|lccn=2019757770}}
* {{cite book|last1=Bricmont|first1=Jean|title=Quantum Sense and Nonsense|date=2017|publisher=Springer|isbn=978-3319652719|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Frg7DwAAQBAJ|lccn=2019744992}}
